summary: Batch #39 — Calendar Task view (4th segment) + new GET /api/tasks/upcoming endpoint. BACKEND (/app/backend/tests/test_batch39_tasks_upcoming.py, JUnit /app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_batch39_results.xml): 6/6 PASS in ~1.8s. Verified (1) 401 without a valid token; (2) authenticated response shape {tasks:[...], can_manage:true} where each task carries item_id, list_id, list_name, title, priority, due_date, days_until_due, overdue(bool), assignee(member card or null), scope('mine'|'kids'|'family'); (3) dated tasks form an ascending sequence (undated left as null — frontend puts them in the 'No date' bucket); (4) no _id leak on the response, tasks, or nested assignee; (5) POST /api/todos/items/{id}/toggle round-trip — after toggling a task done it disappears from /tasks/upcoming, and toggling it back restores it (used for cleanup so seed stays intact). FRONTEND (Playwright mobile 390x844 against EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, logged in as storytester@fam.com / secret123): (A) Calendar tab loads and the view switch renders EXACTLY 4 segments — cal-view-month, cal-view-week, cal-view-day, cal-view-task all visible with labels Month / Week / Day / Tasks. (B) Tapping cal-view-task renders Tasks header ('7 open to-dos'), the member filter avatar row, and 7 grouped rows. All 7 seed to-dos ('Book dentist for Anaya' [High], 'Fix the garden gate', 'Plan Grandma's party' [High], 'Sunscreen', 'Swimsuits', 'Chargers', 'First-aid kit') have due_date=null so they correctly bucket under the 'No date' group header (count 7). Each row shows title, optional 'High' tag (visible on the two flagged items with red flag icon), the list-name meta ('Family Tasks' or 'Vacation Packing') with list-outline icon, and the assignee avatar on the right. cal-task-<id> row testIDs + cal-task-check-<id> tap targets present for all 7 items. (C) TOGGLE — tapping cal-task-check-tdi_03bbb3168bc74000 (Book dentist for Anaya) removed that row from the DOM (rows 7 → 6) and the same task no longer appears in a fresh GET /api/tasks/upcoming call, confirming end-to-end wiring; restored via /toggle for cleanup. (D) MEMBER FILTER — tapping cal-member-mem_29ad14388e9549b5 (Raj) filtered the task list from 6 → 1 row (only Raj-assigned tasks); tapping the same chip again cleared the filter. (E) REGRESSION — switching back to cal-view-month, cal-view-week, cal-view-day all rendered without crashes (Day view shows Wed 19 Aug agenda with 'Swimming Class' event card + assignee avatar + Remind action, as expected). No React Native red screen, only benign expo-notifications and pointerEvents deprecation warnings. Demo data left intact: Book-dentist task toggled back to open, all 7 seeded to-dos remain in the list.
action_items: None blocking. Optional: seed a couple of dated to-dos (one overdue, one due today, one this-week, one later) so the Task view visually exercises the other 4 group headers (Overdue / Due today / This week / Later) — currently all 7 seeded tasks have due_date=null so the Task view only shows the 'No date' bucket in the demo family.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py:2865-2901 GET /tasks/upcoming — family-scoped ({family_id: fid}) query, uses require_family/member_for_user, resolves list_names once, memoises assignee member cards via mcache to avoid N+1, sorts by due_date ascending. scope() correctly returns 'mine' | 'kids' | 'family'. can_manage is true for role in ('admin','parent'). No _id fields exposed (projection {_id:0}).

backend/server.py:2745-2758 POST /todos/items/{id}/toggle already enforces family scoping and sets done/done_by_member_id/done_at atomically — pairs cleanly with /tasks/upcoming's {done: {$ne: True}} filter so a toggled-done task disappears from the list.

frontend/app/(tabs)/calendar.tsx:56 loadTasks() calls /tasks/upcoming and stores tasks + canManage — happy-path only; if the API errors the tasks list silently stays empty. Consider surfacing a lightweight error toast on catch.

frontend/app/(tabs)/calendar.tsx:253-264 view switch maps ['month','week','day','task'] to segments with correct testIDs cal-view-{month|week|day|task}, active segment gets white background + brandPrimary text — good touch target (segments share row width equally so each ~90px wide on 390 viewport, height ~30px — a bit shorter than 44pt guideline but still fully tappable in practice).

frontend/app/(tabs)/calendar.tsx:414-510 Task view logic — clean grouping by (overdue / today / this-week / later / no-date) using dayjs, empty-state 'All caught up!' when no tasks match filter, per-row testIDs cal-task-<id> + cal-task-check-<id>, High tag gated on priority==='high', assignee avatar rendered only when present, list_name shown with list-outline icon.

frontend/app/(tabs)/calendar.tsx:415 memberFilter respects assignee.member_id, so a task without an assignee is hidden when any member filter is active — this is the expected behaviour for a per-member view.
